newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex to sell reformulated gasoline as of Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Pemex to sell reformulated gasoline as of Tuesday.

text.p: The Mexican government oil monopoly Pemex said it will substitute its Magna Sin unleaded gasoline for a reformulated mixture called Pemex Magna in the Mexico City area starting Tuesday.
"It will help reduce the level of ozone and reduce polluting emisions to benefit air quality for the people of this region," Pemex said in a news release.
Pemex said the new gasoline would reduce hydrocarbon emisions by 12 percent and oxides of nitrogen by four percent, Pemex said.
Pemex said the new gasoline could be used in cars made in Mexico after 1985 that do not have catalytic converters.
